title: Part Collection
heading: The part *collection*
sub: How our parts are meant to work as one set, and how another team could reuse them. The formal record lives on the iGEM Registry.

blocks.body: This page will describe our parts as a single collection: the goal they share, the design logic that connects them, and the system function the set is meant to deliver. No collection has been assembled or verified yet, so nothing is claimed here. The current evidence for each element is on the [Parts](/parts/) page.
An architecture figure will show which parts combine, which ones can be swapped for alternatives, and which combinations have been tested.
For teams that want the whole set or a single part: the host, the conditions, the known limits and the common problems.
The Registry collection page and each part page carry the sequences, characterisation and usage notes. They are the formal record, and this page will link to them once they exist.
